chapter: Miles Davis stories and what jazz means
title: Miles's car wreck and Gil's letter
summary: Johnston and Gil discuss Miles's recent crash. Gil plans to write urging him to stop driving.

story.theme_name: Playing with and around Miles Davis
story.community_name: Playing with Miles Davis: joining, sessions and the band

blocks.x: Of course, the newspapers have been filled with all kinds of stories about him. He seems to have more than his share of bad luck. Getting shot and as you say, getting arrested and getting hit over the head and all sorts of things.
Yes I know. Oh by driving by himself and wrecked this fantastically expensive car. Broke two legs. Anybody else would break one, have to but Miles would/break two. (LAUGHTER).

He has to stop driving his car because it's not the first time he's had a wreck. Although he has been lucky before but he just wasn't lucky this time. He's had a couple of other wrecks like that. So he's going to have to stop driving. No point in driving that's going to if you let those things happen to you.
I'm going to write to him and tell him he can do me a personal favor and stop driving cars.
Because I like him. I like to have him around.
Oh, when you said you were going to write to him I thought maybe......
I just want to put in on paper.
